# Galaxy UDT Templates And Troubleshooting

Read only the section needed for the current UDT.

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a pinned BioContainer found through one
bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without
`docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

For generated glue scripts, avoid nested `python -c` quoting. A base64 argument
keeps the script as one shell token:

```bash
SCRIPT_B64='BASE64_WITHOUT_NEWLINES'
python -c 'import base64, pathlib, sys; pathlib.Path("job.py").write_bytes(base64.b64decode(sys.argv[1]))' "$SCRIPT_B64"
python job.py "$(inputs.inpu

representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(apeglm))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
dat <- read.csv(args[1], header=TRUE, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
stopifnot(ncol(dat) == 7L)
stopifnot(identical(colnames(dat), c("geneID","KL1","KL2","KL3","WL1","WL2","WL3")))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(dat[["geneID"]]))
count_mat <- as.matrix(dat[, -1, drop=FALSE])
storage.mode(count_mat) <- "integer"
rownames(count_mat) <- dat[["geneID"]]
condition <- factor(c(rep("KL", 3), rep("WL", 3)), levels=c("WL","KL"))
coldata <- data.frame(row.names=colnames(count_mat), condition=condition)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=count_mat, colData=coldata, design=~condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds, quiet=TRUE)
coef_name <- "condition_KL_vs_WL"
res <- results(dds, name=coef_name, alpha=0.05)
shr <- lfcShrink(dds, coef=coef_name, res=res, type="apeglm")
out <- as.data.frame(shr)
out <- data.frame(geneID=rownames(out), out, check.names=FALSE)
write.table(out, file="deseq2_shrunken.tsv", sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
keep <- !is.na(out[["pvalue"]]) & out[["pvalue"]] < 0.05 &
        !is.na(out[["log2FoldChange"]]) & abs(out[["log2FoldChange"]]) > 1 &
        !is.na(out[["baseMean"]]) & out[["baseMean"]] > 10
writeLines(out[["geneID"]][keep], con="significant_ensembl.txt")
diag <- c(
  paste0("DESeq2=", as.character(packageVersion("DESeq2"))),
  paste0("apeglm=", as.character(packageVersion("apeglm"))),
  paste0("design=~condition"),
  paste0("coefficient=", coef_name),
  paste0("shrinkage=apeglm"),
  paste0("pvalue_threshold=0.05"),
  paste0("abs_shrunken_log2FoldChange_threshold=1"),
  paste0("baseMean_threshold=10"),
  paste0("input_genes=", nrow(out)),
  paste0("significant_genes=", sum(keep))
)
writeLines(diag, con="diagnostics.txt")
RSCRIPT
Rscript analysis.R "$(inputs.counts.path)"
